name: Organizr
description: Self-updater is C (HTTPS, no payload verify), but the Plugin/Theme Marketplace explicitly sets verify_peer=>false for the GitHub hosts it downloads executable PHP plugin code from — TLS bypass on a code path. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The marketplace helper disables verify_peer only when a non-empty GitHub token is configured; the default token is empty. Plugin/theme installs therefore support an opt-in plugin-channel finding, not a default primary updater tier.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.
